using System;

internal sealed class Payload
{
    public int A { get; init; }
    public int B { get; init; }
}

internal static class Program
{
    private static int trace;
    private static int Step(int value) { trace = trace * 10 + value; return value; }
    private static int Sum(int first, int second, int third) => first + second + third;
    private static Payload Keep(Payload value) => value;
    private static bool Both(bool first, bool second)
    {
        return first
            && second;
    }

    private static int Multiline(int value)
    {
        return Math.Abs(
            value);
    }

    private static int Forward()
    {
        return Sum(
            1,
            2,
            3);
    }

    private static void Main()
    {
        // The literal and this comment must survive verbatim.
        var text = "{ braces } // text, &&";
        var payload = Keep(new Payload
        {
            A = Step(1),
            B = Step(2)
        });
        int[] values =
        [
            1,
            2
        ];
        if (Both(true, true))
        {
            Console.WriteLine(text);
        }
        Console.WriteLine(Sum(Step(3), Step(4), Step(5)));
        Console.WriteLine(Forward());
        /* Keep this block comment and both literal tokens. */
        Console.WriteLine(string.Concat("first-width-probe-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-0123456789", "second-width-probe-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-0123456789"));
        Console.WriteLine($"{trace}:{payload.A}:{payload.B}:{values.Length}:{Multiline(-3)}");
        // Semantic cleanup must leave this concatenation alone (CR1100).
        Console.WriteLine(text + ".lock");
    }
}
